description:
Free, open-source incremental backup software for Windows that stores backups as ordinary browsable files.

Fast-Backup copies only files that have changed after the first backup. It stores backups as ordinary files and folders instead of using a proprietary archive, supports file history and point-in-time restore, and can run through its graphical interface or command line.
Fast-Backup 4.01 is the first open-source release. The Windows installers are digitally signed, and the source code is available under the MIT License.
